sections.text:
[Effects]
Nullifies status ailments.
Increases status ailment resistance by 20 activates as a Blessing skill when Dragon Tempest Steel Core, Dragon Tempest Steel Guard, and Dragon Tempest Steel Garb Gear pieces are equipped in the Main Slot.

[Activation]
When an Ability that causes Poison, Prohibit Unison, Paralysis, Confuse, or Blind is used against you.

[Activation Rate]
M+
